name: Conv-boundary fixed-range QAT and paired float continuation, development v2
scope: Training/validation only. No fresh holdout claim. No old evaluation/future holdout image forward in this stage. Not an FPGA or all-integer implementation.
calibration: Same64 training images as previous PTQ, deterministic BodyTransform; all fake quantisation disabled while observing float folded model; freeze all activation and weight scales before training, no validation calibration.

quantisation.input_and_output: UINT8 affine MinMax per tensor, range0..255
quantisation.weight: INT8 symmetric per output channel, range-128..127
quantisation.bn: Fold in eval with stored running statistics
quantisation.observers: Frozen after train-only calibration; weights trained with straight-through fake-quant operations

paired_control: Identical source folded weights, training sample and augmentation seeds, optimiser, steps and loss. Float continuation has quantisers disabled throughout, QAT enabled throughout. All seeds reported.

training.loss: mean(1-cos(student, frozen source teacher)) +0.25*batch-hard Euclidean triplet margin0.3
training.teacher: Source trained encoder in eval on same augmented image; no validation/query training
training.checkpoint: Fixed final epoch6; no checkpoint/seed selection

validation: Existing5 registered+6unknown; galleryAug14 queriesAug18. Thresholds from ORT reference graph only using previous empirical FAR<=0.05 rule. Existing validation has been reused; exploratory development evidence.
reference_runtime: CPU ORT1.23.2 optimisations disabled for reproducibility after previous default Windows mismatch. Default optimised output separately retained; not used to hide differences.
next_gate: If training-only smoke export or finite real gradients fail, preserve artifacts and diagnose before full run; do not weaken fixed tolerances.

numerical_implementation.weight_fake_quant: Explicit FP32 division then nearest-even round as ONNX QuantizeLinear-13, clipped STE. Original PyTorch builtin reciprocal-multiply weight rounding differs at812of912008 weights for training vector probe; failed v1 retained.
numerical_implementation.activation_qparams: Scalar constants per ONNX per-tensor definition; preserve values and quantisation ranges. Raw Torch exports retained.
numerical_implementation.reason: Exact training-tensor export gate failed before any training or validation inference
